info.name: MCDSS - Phase 8 (Applicant Pool)
info.description:
Exercises every Phase 8 (Applicant Pool) deliverable from TEAM_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md against a running `docker compose up -d` stack, plus regression checks for the three gaps found when Lance's implementation (commit cf0faa1) was reviewed against the plan:
1. The `v_active_pool` database view was never created by a migration (fixed by 2026_07_20_000002_create_active_pool_view.php) -- Section 2 includes a manual tinker verification since no HTTP endpoint reads the view directly.
2. `POST /api/hiring-rounds/{id}/close` threw a 422 and refused to close a round that had zero unhired applicants -- Section 3 is a dedicated regression test for this.
3. `GET /api/applicant-pool` was missing the `semester` filter the plan calls for (only `hiring_round_id` existed) -- Section 2 tests it directly.

Prereqs:
1. `docker compose up -d --build`
2. `docker compose exec laravel php artisan migrate --seed` (must include the new `2026_07_20_000002_create_active_pool_view.php` migration).
3. Run once: `docker compose exec laravel php artisan tinker --execute="echo App\Models\Department::first()->id;"` and paste the UUID into the `department_id` collection variable.
4. This collection creates its OWN dedicated hiring rounds via tinker (see '0. Setup') rather than reusing/closing the shared seeded 'AY 2026 Faculty Hiring - 1st Semester' round that Phase 4-7 collections depend on being active -- closing that shared round would break every other collection's fixture setup. `POST /api/applications` auto-attaches whichever active round has the latest `start_date`, so these dedicated rounds are given later start dates so applications created later in this run attach to them, not the shared seeded round.
5. Run the whole collection top-to-bottom via Collection Runner (order matters -- IDs captured earlier are reused later, and Section 3's round must be created after Section 2's round closes).

item.name: [Manual Verification] v_active_pool View Exists and Returns Our 2 Entries [Gap Fix #1]

request.description:
[Known Gap] No HTTP endpoint reads `v_active_pool` directly (the general /api/applicant-pool listing must support all 4 pool statuses via filter, which this view -- hardcoded to `WHERE status = 'active'` -- cannot serve). To confirm the previously-missing migration (2026_07_20_000002_create_active_pool_view.php) actually created the view and it's queryable, run:

  docker compose exec laravel php artisan tinker --execute='echo DB::table("v_active_pool")->where("original_round", "Phase 8 Test Round")->count();'

Expected: 2 (B and C are both still pool_status='active' at this point in the run -- run this BEFORE the reengage/status-update steps below, since those move B and C out of 'active').

exec: pm.test('See request description -- no API exists to assert this automatically', () => pm.expect(true).to.eql(true));
